entries.meaning: The controller's own supply range, not a battery charging limit.
D+ maximum output current 250 mA; the charging-fail threshold is adjustable (no default value is given in the datasheet).

Overspeed (ANSI 12), underspeed (14), undervoltage (27), aux battery undervoltage (27X), overvoltage, overfrequency (81O), underfrequency (81U), reverse power (32R), among others. The datasheet lists functions only; trip settings are not given.

gaps: The InteliLite 4 AMF 25 Global Guide (setpoints, defaults, alarm texts) was not found as a public download in this session; setpoint values remain per controller configuration — NOT VERIFIED.
